claim: In the first service credit table of the ElastiCache SLA (Monthly Uptime Percentage), a monthly uptime percentage less than 99.99% but equal to or greater than 99.0% earns a 10% service credit.
question: ElastiCache SLA: what service credit applies when the monthly uptime is below 99.99%?

values.display: Less than 99.99% but equal to or greater than 99.0%
values.spoken: below ninety-nine point nine nine but at least ninety-nine

qualifiers.scope: monthly billing cycle, Monthly Uptime Percentage table
qualifiers.condition: the table applies to ElastiCache Serverless and Multi-AZ configurations according to the text above it

evidence.quote: | Less than 99.99% but equal to or greater than 99.0% | 10% |
evidence.table_header: | Monthly Uptime Percentage | Service Credit Percentage |
